objective: Recover old P2 attack capability while improving benign-OOD false alarms in one unified A+B student; commissioning is a later separate contribution.
base_contract_semantics: Only explicitly copied unchanged data, student, schedule, optimizer, label, guard and evaluation rules apply. The old three-arm teacher preparation, C2 loss and past execution authorizations do not apply.

historical_AB.access: identity only; no load or new forward

expanded_preparation.reuse: members/*/features.f32le and contexts.jsonl.gz listed in pinned manifest
expanded_preparation.access: E only; no decoding or rematerialization

data.direct_supervision: all fixed 15073 true-label targets once per epoch, no exclusions
data.exposure: All pools are exposed development assets; historical P2 fit includes current-check labels. Q/R use extra historical teacher exposure. Equal direct student labels do not mean equal total knowledge exposure. This is not an independent confirmatory benchmark.

student.architecture: Linear(131,64) -> GELU(exact) -> GRU(64,128,1 layer,unidirectional,bias,dropout0) -> Linear(128,64) -> GELU(exact) -> Linear(64,1)
student.initialization: each arm independently copies identical sealed candidate_A student state; no sequential warm-start between arms
student.prefix_semantics: reuse plan offsets, exact causal target event states, reset boundaries, packed padding and F4 fields

R_projection.input: causal GRU h at each eligible target event

student.deployment_output: Always original qS=head(h); never sum a reconstructed contribution vector.

schedule.owner_order: sort context keys by (SHA256(canonical(['paired-order-v1',2705,epoch,owner,key])),key), epoch 1..20, independently for A and B
schedule.buckets: q,r=divmod(N_owner,197); first r buckets contain q+1 ordered contexts, remaining buckets q
schedule.per_update_order: A then B; each microbatch forward once for all applicable losses; accumulate gradients, global clip once, optimizer step once
schedule.candidate_selection: Final epoch20 only; Q and R final checkpoints sealed before E; no intermediate candidate selection

teacher_cache.eligibility: Reuse exact original canonical-hard-correct current-TRAIN A whitelist; never refilter by a new transformed score.
teacher_cache.index_order: Preserve existing row field (zero-based cache index) and UID/context_key/label association exactly; aggregate contexts by sorted key, eligible rows by UID for deterministic float64 preparation.
teacher_cache.canonical_hard_definition: The sealed index stores canonical_probability and canonical_logit, not a canonical_hard field. Define canonical_hard=(float64(saved canonical_probability)>=float64(0.065159872174263)); require agreement with original TRAIN plan old_hard and true label. Do not recompute sigmoid or teacher inference.

A_guard.eligible: current-train A and saved A hard at logit>=0 equals true label
A_guard.representative: E_c=UID-sorted eligible targets; start=int(sha256(context_key UTF8),16)%len(E_c); epoch e selects E_c[(start+e-1)%len(E_c)]
A_guard.pairs: all attack-representative/benign-representative pairs within original A bucket, distinct component, attack-first once
A_guard.final_audit: reuse final train logits to check union of actual training pairs; report violations, worst gap-minus-margin, family detail; no extra forward
A_guard.guarantee_limit: zero loss on one pair at fixed parameters only implies qS_attack-qS_benign >= min(s_A,(qA_attack-qA_benign)/2); not fixed-zero decisions or unseen-OOD guarantee
A_guard.reuse: Use pinned guard cache and original representative/pair arithmetic; s_A and whitelist fixed, no new A computation.

teacher_balancing.M: mean over all197 M_b at fixed parameters; equivalently 0.5*sum_y mean_eligible_context mean_eligible_target f

task_score.q_T_source: sealed canonical_logit, not inverse sigmoid of saturated probability
task_score.training_cast: m_T32 and s_q32 cast exactly once to float32; seal both float64 provenance and float32 bit patterns
task_score.computation: float32 subtract, then float32 divide, then Huber
task_score.boundary_check: (m_T64>=0) and (m_T32>=0) must each equal saved canonical_hard for every original eligible row
task_score.on_boundary_mismatch: STOP before T, report UIDs/counts; never change threshold, whitelist, label or denominator
task_score.finite_check: All input/output margins and scales must be finite; s_q32>=1.

residual_contribution.computation: e=D(h)-t in float32; r=e-e.mean(dim=-1,keepdim=True) in float32; apply coordinate Huber

P.purpose: Verify existing TRAIN teacher/guard identity; derive centered margins, s_q and residual-energy metadata; seal new derived TRAIN cache
numeric_allowlist: existing9379 TRAIN teacher rows and their index
P.energy_metadata: Compute float64 M[mean128(t**2)] and M[sum128((t-mean128(t))**2)/127]; report even zero, no target rescaling or arm selection

T.purpose: Sequential Q then R; independent sealed-A initialization, original TRAIN prefixes only

E.purpose: One final train/check/expanded evaluation per Q/R; historical scores reused without historical model forward

stages.execution_on_exception: stop, seal reason, zero automatic retries; do not silently drop R, rows, terms or remaining checks
stages.scientific_bad_result: report and seal all completed endpoints; no extra epochs, seeds or coefficient changes
stages.monitoring: Persistent local Windows supervisor, append-only progress journal and human-readable status with terminal verification; no LLM polling
stages.budget_scope: each stage includes entry validation, actual work, result verification and sealing; none may be excluded from stage resource accounting
stages.authorization_chaining: A later explicit P/T/E joint authorization may cover automatic transitions; this design authorizes none.

training_observations.source: original training forwards/backwards only; no additional per-task autograd calls
per_epoch: normalized task-score error and raw-logit error summaries
training_observations.endpoint: Reuse E TRAIN forward for teacher score-error/hard-agreement and R residual-fit diagnostics; D is used only on eligible TRAIN states, no extra student forward.

evaluation.primary_ranking_descriptor: empirical TPR@FPR<=0.01, pooled expanded attacks versus all18000 benign OOD, ties grouped at one global mathematical threshold
secondary_ranking: family recalls at the same pooled mathematical threshold
fixed_point_reports: 16 attack families plus macro and worst regression

contrasts.R-Q: extra residual contribution plus auxiliary training package
contrasts.each_vs_AB_C0_P2: practical capability and low-FPR references, disclose A/B missing semantics

evaluation.development_joint_gain: same contrast no worse in primary ranking, fixed overall/future/family-macro recall and benign pool-macro/worst FP, at least one better; single-seed tiny differences are not a breakthrough
evaluation.practical_milestone: reach old fixed-point attack/future references and jointly improve benign OOD; disclose any key family/pool collapse; no invented allowed-loss tolerance
evaluation.practical_verdict: manual scientific interpretation of the complete metric table; no automatic SUCCESS from undefined serious-regression tolerances
evaluation.reference_comparison: use exact numerator and denominator; rounded percentages are display only

new_candidate_retention_diagnostics.outputs: count,UIDs,is_zero separately for Q and R; never replaces historical verdicts

claim_limits: exposed development only; historical teacher saw current-check labels
single seed; no independent confirmation; tiny gains are not a breakthrough
source shortcuts possible; no verified same-device benign/attack pairing
Q may act as finite-confidence regularization, not sample-specific knowledge
R includes auxiliary regularization, extra parameters and shared clipping effects
contribution-space orthogonality is not gradient orthogonality or causal feature use
0.1% FPR supports at most18 false positives on18000 OOD, not precise stable population FPR
151 ID targets do not establish0.1% ID FPR; future-query is not automatically unseen attack families
P2 B default alarms are not content-recognition; old overall denominator is preserved
one recipe failure does not falsify all knowledge transfer
evaluation.low_FPR_caveat: Preserve original joint-gain rule, separately disclose0.1% ranking and every family/pool collapse; do not hide deterioration behind the macro rule.

diagnostic.numeric_access_stage: published diagnostic report only in this design

continuation.Q_joint_gain_R_no_gain: Retain simpler Q as development candidate; assess practical milestone and confirm mechanism before claim.
continuation.R_over_Q_joint_gain: Extra auxiliary structure warrants further targeted confirmation; not yet pure contribution-knowledge proof.
continuation.attack_up_OOD_or_low_FPR_worse: TRADEOFF, not joint success; no automatic commissioning success claim.
continuation.fit_improves_joint_capability_does_not: Stop automatic extensions of this recipe; reassess available information, behavior coverage and boundary learning. Transfer route not universally falsified.
continuation.fit_still_poor: Use logged evidence to identify a specific optimization/representation obstacle before any new authorized revision; no automatic extra epochs or search.

required_before_paper_attribution.Q_sample_specific_teacher_claim: Later freeze Q_const with same whitelist/weights/s_q and class-context-weighted per-label mean margin
required_before_paper_attribution.R_contribution_information_claim: Later freeze R_perm preserving Q and shuffling residual targets within label and eligible-context-size strata

implementation_acceptance: generated-only tests; no implicit new real P/T/E authorization
exact original TRAIN whitelist/denominators and UID-row association; strict phase-specific numeric allowlists
float64 canonical-logit centering, fixed TRAIN scale, float32 cast and both boundary-sign checks; mismatch stops without refilter
nonuniform class/context toy fixtures prove full-epoch normalizations; overshoot gets opposite Huber gradient to BCE as expected
projection before Huber; sum128/127 exactly, no double mean; common additive contribution offset invariance within floating tolerance
Q gradient reaches original head/encoder; R zero-D first-step encoder residual gradient and later nonzero path; direct R-to-head residual gradient zero
original student forward and causal early-target states exactly preserved; no old classifier deployed
same sealed-A starts, reset optimizers, original deterministic order, presentations, updates and final-only candidates
label/guard and no-new-teacher numerical path match historical C1 shared-base semantics; otherwise stop comparability claim
R train-only D removed from deployment; Q head unchanged by reconstructed-contribution calculation
tie-aware pooled ranking, exact denominators, separate A/B/ID interpretation and original retention reports
Python3.9 Windows concurrent status readers, append-only progress, persistent Job supervision, budget and exception zero-retry
implementation and generated acceptance sealed before any separately authorized real execution
